title: Median-of-R(k)/S_unit(k) singular-series fit (2C2) — N=1e7 precision check
context: E62 (N=1e6) AGREEMENT with the median estimator (1.395/1.451 vs 1.32032±0.15). E63 runs the same estimator at N=1e7 to confirm the agreement holds at higher resolution; the E62 CI [1.279, 1.660] comfortably covers 1.32032, so this is a precision check, not a direction check.
verdict: AGREEMENT — 2C2 disc=1.459 hold=1.470 in 1.32032±0.15 at N=1e7 with the median estimator (E62 N=1e6 1.395/1.451, Δ -0.063); G1 D=1.319 vs nulls 0.023; G2 stable. Agreement holds at higher resolution.
